verdicts.reason: A: the wind-turbine hero is shrunk to a speck and lined up in a tiny strip with clipped triangle fragments on the left. The headline is jammed to the right at mid-height, and the lower half is dead space with two stray lines, so the design is wrecked. B: the headline is centred and readable, but the turbine and the coloured triangles are also shrunk into a cramped icon row along the bottom edge. A long diagonal line cuts through the empty middle, so the original composition, with the turbine centred above the title, is lost. Still, B is more legible and balanced than A.
